findings.title: Loopback-only server binding
findings.explanation: A Python startup call binds to loopback. A guarded development startup block may be overridden by production, but no clear resolving override was established for this call.
findings.recommended_fix: Configure the production server to bind to 0.0.0.0 or the platform-required interface.

findings.title: Hardcoded application port
findings.explanation: A Python startup call uses a literal port. This can be valid, but a PaaS may require an environment-supplied port.
findings.recommended_fix: Read the platform port from an environment variable, with an appropriate local default.

findings.title: Potential local persistent storage
findings.explanation: SQLite, file writes, or local storage configuration may require durable storage. SQLite is not inherently unsuitable; container filesystems may be ephemeral.
findings.recommended_fix: Review persistence needs; configure a durable volume or external storage and backups when necessary.

findings.title: No Dockerfile detected
findings.explanation: A Dockerfile was not detected. Many cloud platforms also support source builds, so this does not prevent cloud deployment.
findings.recommended_fix: For a container-based deployment, add and review a Dockerfile in a later configuration step.

findings.title: No .dockerignore detected
findings.explanation: A container build ignore file was not detected; future build contexts should exclude secrets, caches, and local dependencies.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a .dockerignore before container builds to exclude environment files, caches, and development artifacts.

findings.title: Python runtime version is unknown
findings.explanation: No single supported Python version declaration could be determined; the runtime may be declared elsewhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Declare a supported Python version in .python-version or pyproject.toml project.requires-python.

migration_recommendations: Configure the production server to bind to 0.0.0.0 or the platform-required interface.
Read the platform port from an environment variable, with an appropriate local default.
Review persistence needs; configure a durable volume or external storage and backups when necessary.
For a container-based deployment, add and review a Dockerfile in a later configuration step.
Add a .dockerignore before container builds to exclude environment files, caches, and development artifacts.
Declare a supported Python version in .python-version or pyproject.toml project.requires-python.

After reviewing these findings, consider a container-based PaaS with a managed HTTP service, environment-injected configuration, health checks, and durable storage when needed. No provider is provisioned or deployed by Ascend.
assessment_limitations: Static analysis does not guarantee successful deployment; review and test the production configuration.
Only static Python source and supported metadata in the selected scope are inspected; production commands, external services, and deployment behavior are not verified.
